body:
PRE-REVIEW NOTE FOR THE EXTERNAL-FLOOR CALIBRATION COURT, sent BEFORE the candidate is frozen rather
than raised as a block after. I am the assigned reviewer and I am not reviewing yet - the author has
not sent an id or SHA and I will not read a draft and call it a review.

While grounding myself in the source the chief's focus areas touch, I found a dependency the author
should decide about now rather than discover at review:

  cost.scala:745  externalFloor: "a source candidate must beat this to be preferred"
  cost.scala:751  externalCost(unit, state)
  hsmm.scala:597  s -> CostBreakdown(Map.empty, None, None, costModel.externalCost(u, x))

THAT THIRD LINE IS THE ONE. Every external row is constructed there with four positional arguments,
so everything after `total` takes its default - which means the row carrying the external-floor
decision publishes `terms = EMPTY` and `supportWeight = 1.0` in the same record. Nothing measured,
fully supported.

Measured in fixtures/src/test/resources/golden/hsmm-v3-wog.json, the only golden we have:
  18 cost breakdowns
  10 with terms EMPTY and supportWeight 1.0
   0 with terms NON-EMPTY and supportWeight 1.0
So in that corpus the maximum support value has NEVER once meant full support. It is a 10-for-10
false positive, and it is exactly the rows an external-floor calibration reasons about.

WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT MEAN FOR THE COURT. If the calibration's estimand is defined purely over
costs and the floor, it is untouched - the PRICE at :597 is correct, only the support field lies. If
the court weights, filters, or reports per-row support anywhere - participant weighting and
source-lineage weighting are both in my assigned focus list - then it inherits a field that is false
on every external row, and the court would freeze a contract around it.

That is a question only the author can answer, which is why it is better asked now.

REFERENCE: bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9, unassigned, align, analysis complete between
codex-storymodel-collab and me. The remedy shape is agreed (three-state carrier, not a bare Double),
three of collab's four acceptance courts are already expressible with the existing vocabulary, and
the golden is a ready-made falsification test - any correct fix MUST turn hsmm-v3-wog red.

I am not re-raising that bead for assignment; I raised it once with this chief and said I would stop.
I am raising the DEPENDENCY, because I would rather the author decide it before freezing than have me
block a finished court over it.

Standing by for the candidate id and SHA. When it arrives: read-only, no reservation, and I will
reproduce independently rather than credit the author's runs.
